The pipeline demonstrated is 'text-generation', indicating its primary function as a generative model.

stories.title: Muse Glimmer from Meta Superintelligence Labs is now available
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Meta has released Muse Glimmer, its first open model from Superintelligence Labs.
Muse Glimmer is a 30B multimodal model released under the permissive Apache 2.0 license.
It is optimized for local coding agents and features native DFlash and image input support via Ollama's MLX engine.

stories.title: LAION-BVD: A 10-Million-Hour Open Video Dataset for Multimodal Pre-training
stories.author: Matthias Bethge
bullet_points: Introduction of LAION-BVD, a massive, open-source video dataset for multimodal learning.
The dataset comprises 80 million videos totaling 10 million hours, sourced from CommonCrawl.
It is specifically designed to facilitate multimodal pre-training across video, audio, and image modalities.

stories.title: LAION-BVD: A 10-Million-Hour Open Video Dataset for Multimodal Pre-training
stories.author: Matthias Bethge
bullet_points: Introduction of LAION-BVD, a massive open video dataset designed for multimodal learning.
The dataset comprises 80 million videos totaling 10 million hours, sourced from CommonCrawl.
It supports multimodal pre-training across video, audio, and image modalities, with synthetic caption generation used for training.

stories.title: Google Expands Gemini Into an Agent Platform for Building and Running Business AI
stories.author: alifar
bullet_points: Google Cloud launched the Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform, a new developer tool.
This platform is designed to facilitate the building and deployment of business-focused AI agents.
It represents a significant push by Google to operationalize generative AI for enterprise use cases.

stories.title: 🤗 Trending: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: The news highlights a trending model, deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1, on Hugging Face.
The model is categorized for text-generation tasks, indicating its primary function.
It utilizes standard ML frameworks like transformers and safetensors.

stories.title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning, a 30B parameter open model, is now available via Ollama.
The model is specifically designed for autonomous agents capable of multi-step tasks and context gathering.
It is optimized to run locally on user hardware, emphasizing on-device AI capabilities.

stories.title: Ollama: all aboard open models
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama, a platform for running open models, has secured significant funding.
The company raised $88 million in a funding round.
Ollama currently serves a substantial developer base of 8.9 million users.

stories.title: Faster Gemma 4 on MLX with multi-token prediction
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Gemma 4 performance is significantly boosted on Apple Silicon when running through Ollama 0.31.
The speed improvement is achieved via Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) utilizing the MLX framework.
Coding agent performance shows up to a 90% speed increase, as validated by the Aider polyglot benchmark.

stories.title: Ollama's highest performance on Apple Silicon yet with MLX
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama has achieved its peak performance on Apple Silicon.
The performance boost is attributed to updates in its MLX engine.
Improvements include faster response times, higher output quality, and reduced memory usage.

stories.title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Ultra
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: NVIDIA is introducing Nemotron 3 Ultra.
The model is specifically designed for high-throughput reasoning tasks.
It is optimized for complex, long-running agent workflows.

stories.title: OpenJarvis: a local-first personal AI is now available to run with Ollama
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: OpenJarvis v1.0 is released, providing an open-source framework for personal AI agents.
The key feature is the ability to run these AI agents locally on the user's own hardware.
It integrates native support for Ollama, facilitating the use of local LLMs.

stories.title: Ollama is now powered by MLX on Apple Silicon in preview
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama, a popular local LLM runner, is integrating MLX for enhanced performance on Apple Silicon.
The integration leverages MLX, Apple's native machine learning framework, for optimized execution.
This is currently available in a preview build, signaling a major step toward optimized local AI on Apple hardware.

stories.title: Reading Is Not Using: Retrieval, Judgment, and the Design of AI Financial Research Workflows
stories.author: Zhizhe Liu
bullet_points: The paper addresses a critical flaw in current LLM evaluation for financial analysis: focusing only on information retrieval rather than the impact of retrieved data on final judgment.
It identifies a 'retrieval-integration gap' in long-context financial analysis, suggesting LLMs may be adept at finding data but poor at synthesizing it for decision-making.
The research uses large-scale context variation (2k to 128k tokens) to empirically test how external, unrelated context influences the AI's analysis of specific financial risk disclosures.

stories.title: What FID Hides: Detecting, Ranking, and Diagnosing Deviations in Generative Evaluation
stories.author: Hao Chen
bullet_points: The paper critiques the limitations of standard generative model evaluation metrics like FID and KID.
It highlights that FID's reliance on only the first two moments can obscure significant distributional differences in generated samples.
The research proposes methods to detect, rank, and diagnose deviations in generative models beyond simple scalar distance metrics.

stories.title: Effective Learning Rate Governs Loss Dynamics in Language Model Pretraining
stories.author: Lei Wu
bullet_points: Identifies 'ELR collapse' in language model pretraining, suggesting a critical role for the Effective Learning Rate (ELR).
Demonstrates that loss dynamics are primarily governed by the ratio of learning rate (LR) and parameter norm, not individually.
Shows that matching ELR across different configurations (optimizers, architectures, scales) leads to highly consistent loss trajectories.

stories.title: Claude Desktop support with Ollama
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Claude Desktop now supports Ollama as a third-party gateway.
This integration allows users to run open-source models within the Claude Desktop environment.
It bridges proprietary AI platforms with local, open-weight model ecosystems.

stories.title: Improved performance and model support with GGUF
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama 0.30 release introduces performance improvements and enhanced GGUF model compatibility.
The update leverages llama.cpp to broaden model support across various hardware configurations.
It augments Ollama's MLX engine, particularly benefiting users on Apple silicon.

stories.title: Google’s new AI transcription edits out your ‘ums’ and ‘ahs’
stories.author: Jess Weatherbed
bullet_points: Google has introduced Gemini 3.5 Transcribe, an update to Gemini Audio.
The new transcription feature automatically edits out filler words like 'ums' and 'ahs'.
The model supports specialized jargon detection and over 85 languages.

stories.title: Volvo’s cars will warn one another about hazards in the road
stories.author: Andrew J. Hawkins
bullet_points: Volvo is integrating new connected safety features into three of its electric vehicles.
The system allows vehicles to warn each other about hazards, such as animals or vulnerable road users.
This technology relies on vehicle-to-vehicle communication rather than traditional crowdsourced navigation alerts.

stories.title: Xbox announces disc-to-digital feature that digitizes your physical games
stories.author: Tom Warren
bullet_points: Xbox is introducing a new disc-to-digital feature for existing physical game collections.
The feature is positioned as part of Microsoft's efforts toward game preservation.
This development is also noted as preparation for future Xbox console generations.

stories.title: Xbox’s new disc-to-digital program gives physical games a digital future
stories.author: Kyle Orland
bullet_points: Xbox is implementing a disc-to-digital program for its consoles.
The program allows users to transition physical game ownership to digital formats.
Most Xbox One and Series X games are compatible with this transition, and discs remain functional after claiming.

stories.title: 15,000 years of solar wind in four hours? A Seattle company gives it a go.
stories.author: Eric Berger
bullet_points: A Seattle company is testing a technology to harness solar wind energy.
The project aims to simulate or utilize solar wind energy over a short period (four hours).
The context suggests an effort to address resource scarcity, specifically mentioning the Moon.

stories.title: Psychiatry’s diagnostic bible is finally getting a biological upgrade
stories.author: Anand Kumar, The Conversation
bullet_points: Psychiatry's diagnostic standards are beginning to incorporate biological data.
The integration of biology into psychiatric manuals is a developing field.
The current challenge remains the scarcity of reliable biological biomarkers for diagnosis.

stories.title: IBM's new Granite 4.2 models ride the wave of interest in local LLMs
stories.author: Samuel Axon
bullet_points: IBM has released new Granite 4.2 LLM models.
The models are specifically designed to cater to the growing demand for local LLM deployment.
Key features emphasized include agentic capability and predictable enterprise integration.

stories.title: The world's busiest spaceport is about to get a lot quieter, at least for now
stories.author: Stephen Clark
bullet_points: SpaceX is targeting the end of the year for Starship launches from Florida.
The timeline for Starship operations is being revised, with 2027 appearing more probable.
The news relates to the operational status and future schedule of a major spaceport.

stories.title: Recursive Experiential-Working Memory Evolution for Long-Horizon Agent Harnesses
stories.author: Ling Yang
bullet_points: Introduces 'Recuris,' a new architecture designed to manage long-horizon tasks for AI agents.
It uses a recursive Experiential-Working Memory system to track task progress and guide skill selection.
The design aims to overcome issues where long task histories obscure the current state and misalign skill usage.

stories.title: SPO++: Stream-Aligned Policy Optimization for Asynchronous Agentic RL
stories.author: Zihe Huang
bullet_points: Introduces SPO++, a novel approach to Stream-Aligned Policy Optimization for Asynchronous Agentic Reinforcement Learning (RL).
Addresses the computational cost of waiting for sibling rollouts in group-relative RL, which is problematic for long, variable tool-use trajectories.
Fixes a mismatch in SPO by standardizing the optimization process, as trajectory centering does not properly center the token-weighted actor loss.

stories.title: FedV-KGQA: Multi-Hop Question Answering over Vertically Partitioned Knowledge Graphs
stories.author: Oshani Seneviratne
bullet_points: Addresses the real-world challenge of distributed knowledge graphs due to data sovereignty constraints.
Proposes FedV-KGQA, a framework for multi-hop question answering across vertically partitioned knowledge graphs.
The approach allows organizations to share entities while maintaining ownership over disjoint sets of relations.

stories.title: Constrained Entity Selection under Partial Knowledge for LLM-Based Knowledge Graph QA
stories.author: Emanuel Kitzelmann
bullet_points: Addresses the challenge of LLMs failing to accurately ground answers in Knowledge Graphs (KGs) during KGQA.
Proposes a new method: Constrained Entity Selection under Partial Knowledge, aiming to improve robustness over traditional SPARQL parsing or pure LLM reasoning.
The research targets the gap between brittle, formal query methods and less guaranteed, LLM-based generation methods.

stories.title: Strictly Causal Streaming Video Anomaly Detection with a Theoretically-Grounded State-Space Core
stories.author: Yogesh Kumar
bullet_points: Introduces a strictly causal streaming video anomaly detector using State-Space Models (SSMs) like Mamba.
Addresses limitations of prior work by ensuring O(1) time and memory update per incoming frame.
Focuses on theoretical grounding and edge hardware efficiency rather than just GPU throughput.

stories.title: Automatic Model Card Generation Using an LLM
stories.author: Cor-Paul Bezemer
bullet_points: The paper addresses the lack of standardized and consistent model cards for ML models, hindering transparency.
It introduces MCTidy, an LLM-based approach designed to reorganize existing model cards into a standardized template.
The goal is to improve the clarity, comparability, and accountability of machine learning models.

stories.title: StarHarness: Evolving Harnesses with Stratified Search for Enterprise Environments
stories.author: Sagar Davasam
bullet_points: StarHarness is a new framework designed to evolve environment-specific agent harnesses without altering core model weights.
The harness evolution covers various components, including prompt framing, tool interfaces, subagent structure, and agent-loop configuration.
It employs stratified search by classifying tasks based on baseline failure behavior to create a compact evolution pool.

stories.title: BioKERN: Biological Kernel Regularization for Histology-to-Transcriptomics Neighborhood Retrieval
stories.author: Betul Orcan-Ekmekci
bullet_points: BioKERN is a new multimodal spatial representation-learning framework designed for histology-to-transcriptomics data.
It addresses a limitation in existing methods by explicitly incorporating biological neighborhood structure as a learnable inductive bias.
The goal is to preserve biological context among non-paired spots, moving beyond simple instance-level matching.

stories.title: A Geometric Theory of Robust Fairness Audits
stories.author: Binita Maity
bullet_points: The paper addresses a critical gap in fairness auditing by examining the robustness of neighborhood-based fairness methods.
It highlights that small perturbations in feature space can significantly alter local neighborhoods, leading to inconsistent fairness assessments.
The authors introduce a new geometric framework to rigorously analyze the stability and robustness of these fairness auditing procedures.

stories.title: LION: A Clifford Neural Paradigm for Multimodal-Attributed Graph Learning
stories.author: Guoren Wang
bullet_points: The research introduces LION, a new Clifford Neural Paradigm designed for Multimodal-Attributed Graph Learning.
The field is shifting towards multimodal-attributed graphs to improve data representation and expand graph ML applications.
Current neural paradigms are limited, particularly in how they handle context during modality alignment.

stories.title: BrowserForge: Scaling Web Episode via Parallel Browser Sandboxes
stories.author: Yongliang Shen
bullet_points: BrowserForge addresses the data scarcity problem for training web agents that interact via rendered pixels.
It proposes scaling web episode generation using parallel browser sandboxes to produce large interaction trajectories.
This method aims to overcome the limitations of current datasets, which are small and restricted to narrow sets of websites.

stories.title: Reading Is Not Using: Retrieval, Judgment, and the Design of AI Financial Research Workflows
stories.author: Zhizhe Liu
bullet_points: The paper addresses a 'retrieval-integration gap' in how LLMs are used for financial analysis, noting that current evaluations focus only on retrieval, not judgment.
It investigates how the volume of unrelated context (up to 128,000 tokens) affects the influence of specific risk disclosures on AI judgments.
This research is highly relevant to the practical deployment and reliability of LLMs in high-stakes fields like AI-assisted investment decisions.

stories.title: Linear Probing Provides Robust and Efficient Detection of Machine-Generated Text
stories.author: Elena Simperl
bullet_points: The research addresses the critical need for robust detection of machine-generated text (MGT) to prevent misuse.
The study proposes that simple linear probes are highly effective at distinguishing MGT from human-written text (HWT).
A key finding is that these linear probes are substantially more sample-efficient and perform better out-of-domain (OOD) compared to complex supervised detectors.

stories.title: ExpConCAD: Experience-Guided Text-to-CAD Generation from Shape Descriptions with Implicit Spatial Constraints
stories.author: See-Kiong Ng
bullet_points: The research addresses the challenge of generating executable CAD programs from natural language descriptions.
Existing text-to-CAD methods struggle with underspecified inputs that lack critical spatial constraints.
The proposed method, ExpConCAD, infers missing spatial constraints by leveraging underlying construction structure and design experience.

stories.title: The RAT: A Unified Bayesian Model for RAG Evaluation
stories.author: Jan Deriu
bullet_points: Introduces 'The RAT,' a unified Bayesian model specifically designed for evaluating Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems.
The framework jointly models key pipeline components: retrieval success, answer correctness, and abstention behavior.
It provides a granular analysis by factorizing the model according to the information flow within the RAG pipeline.

stories.title: SkillForge: Evolving Verifiable Skills for Reinforcement Learning Agents
stories.author: Xiangxiang Chu
bullet_points: SkillForge addresses a limitation in RL agents where learned skills are not verifiable or reusable across different episodes.
The research focuses on improving skill-based approaches for LLM agents trained with Reinforcement Learning (RL).
It introduces a framework to evolve and verify skills, moving beyond simple append-only skill repositories.

stories.title: Study Reveals UnitedHealth's Profit Margins Four Times What It Claimed [pdf]
stories.author: CGMthrowaway
bullet_points: A study alleges that UnitedHealth Group's actual profit margins are significantly higher than previously reported.
The finding suggests a major discrepancy in the financial disclosures of a large healthcare corporation.
The source is a PDF shared on Hacker News, indicating a deep-dive analysis or investigative report.

stories.title: CoMaps: The Offline App That Guided Rescuers Without a Signal in Venezuela
stories.author: gedankenstuecke
bullet_points: CoMaps is an offline application designed to assist rescue operations.
The app functions in environments lacking cellular or internet connectivity, such as in Venezuela.
It demonstrates practical application of location-based technology in critical, real-world scenarios.

stories.title: Introducing AI Disclosure on DEV: Tools for Nuance, Clarity, and Better Feeds
stories.author: ben
bullet_points: Dev.to is implementing structured AI disclosure tiers.
The goal is to increase transparency regarding AI-generated content.
Users will gain more control over their reading experience.

stories.title: Your Agent Planned the Right Tools. It Still Crashed the Machine.
stories.author: p0rt
bullet_points: The article discusses a technical challenge in AI agent design: separating logical planning from physical resource scheduling.
It highlights that even with advanced planning (using frontier models), physical infrastructure limitations can cause system failures.
PeakBench is presented as a framework addressing this disconnect between high-level planning and finite computational resources.
